items.label: One Removable Fabric drawer
items.value: Metal ladder bookshelf with an additional large fabric drawer which is light and soft, matches 4 and 5 tier shelves to store books, toys or other personal items, not only to prevent children from accidentally bumping into corners and injuring themselves, but also to make full use of vertical space to keep your home, office, apartment tidy and organized.

items.label: Multifunctional Ladder Shelf
items.value: This narrow freestanding storage shelves can be used as plant stand, bookcase, bathroom cabinet, storage organizer in your living room, bedroom, kitchen, balcony, office, corridor, bathroom or any other space. In addition to holding the daily necessities, it is also an ideal choice to display some artworks.

items.label: Large Storage Capacity Bookcase
items.value: Industrial ladder book shelf provides ample space for storing any items you want to collect and display. The 3/4 boards of the book shelf get wider from top to bottom can be used to display or store plants, photos, books, CDs, ornaments, collections.

items.label: Safe Design & Premium Material
items.value: The edges of each shelf are designed with backboards to protect your items from falling off. Also, this 5-tier ladder shelf is made of high-quality particle board and solid black metal frame, which is waterproof and durable. Besides, 4 adjustable feet can keep the storage rack organizer stable on the uneven floor and prevent you scratch the floor by moving storage shelves.

items.label: Multiple Choice & Industrial Style
items.value: We offer 2 sizes of 4 and 5 tiers ladder bookshelf. And there are rustic brown, black oak and white bookcases, you can choose the one that best meets your storage needs. At the same time, this standing shelf combines practical design with a vintage look to provide you with the best use experience and suitable for all your other furniture, making it a focal point of your decor.

items.label: Easy to Assemble
items.value: This tall storage rack organizer attached with easy-to-follow instructions, marked parts and necessary tools, and the screw holes are pre-drilled for easy assembly. Ladder shelf dimension: 11.38" D x 16.54"W x 55.59"H

items.label: Worry-free Service
items.value: Furologee provides customer service before and after purchase. If your items received are damaged, scratched or missing parts, please contact us at any time, and we will provide you with satisfactory solutions within 24 hours.
